title: PlayStation’s Tiny Memory Sparked Innovation

scenes.text: When Sony launched a console with just 2 MB RAM
The PlayStation shipped with 2 MB of main RAM and 1 MB of video RAM
Developers used heavy compression and streaming techniques to fit full‑motion video into that space

scenes.text: That limitation forced the birth of iconic CD‑based games with cinematic storytelling
